arStrings.szText: Return to Deckard Cain at the Imperial Library of Caldeum

I found Tal Rasha wandering outside the ruined town of Nostrava. He seemed confused, tormented...shouting something in old Horadric. When I managed to subdue him, he gave a dire warning about "Harrogath" and "the Worldstone." I almost told him both are long gone, but then, a strange portal opened. Whatever torments him must be inside.

I defeated the Echo of Baal within Tal Rasha's nightmare, and Tal Rasha himself appeared, seemingly cleansed. He gave me the remains of his corruption—the "Splinter of Evil" that Baal had driven into his soul. Perhaps the other two wanderers, Sankekur and Aidan, might be helped in the same way? I must return to Deckard and speak of this with him.

Deckard was quite impressed with the "Splinter of Destruction" I brought back, agreeing that both Sankekur and Aidan may suffer from splinters of their own. I must test this theory with Sankekur. Deckard guesses he may have wandered to Hawezar, near to his recently opened tomb. Knowing the man's history, however, he may not want my help.

I found Sankekur just south of Rakhat Keep, preaching like a madman to his thralls. I took him down with some difficulty. Speaking to him, he too seems stuck in the past—still driven by Mephisto to herald the coming of Hell. I must enter his nightmare and put a stop to it. Again.
